# Open questions — Brightsmile Dental online booking

> Generated from `requirements/requirements.json` (run 2026-10-10T09:00Z). Do not edit this file by hand; change the JSON and regenerate.

9 open questions. To answer one, tell the agent in chat (for example "Q-004: no account; match name, date of birth and phone"). It records the answer as yours.

## For the client (8)

### Q-004 [BLOCKING] How does a patient identify themselves when booking: an online account, or details checked against ClinicDesk (e.g. name, date of birth, phone)?

- **Blocks:** FR-001 · **Category:** AUTH
- **Options:** Patient account with login / Details matched to ClinicDesk record / Guest booking, staff verify later
- **Suggested default:** Option: no account; match name, date of birth and phone against the ClinicDesk patient record

### Q-005 [BLOCKING] In which country does the practice operate, and which health-data regulations apply to booking data?

- **Blocks:** FR-001, FR-002 · **Category:** COMPLIANCE
- **Suggested default:** Option: the client names the jurisdiction; the team then lists the obligations for review

### Q-001 [HIGH] What load time should the booking page meet on mobile, and on what kind of connection should it be measured?

- **Blocks:** NFR-001 · **Category:** NFR_TARGET
- **Options:** ≤ 2 s on 4G / ≤ 3 s on 4G / Other target set by the client
- **Suggested default:** Option: page interactive within 3 s on a mid-range phone over 4G (p75 of real visits)

### Q-002 [HIGH] Which treatment types can patients book online: only cleanings and check-ups, or every treatment the practice offers?

- **Blocks:** FR-001 · **Category:** SCOPE
- **Options:** Cleanings and check-ups only / All treatments / A list the practice maintains
- **Suggested default:** Option: only cleanings and check-ups, as named in the story; other treatments stay phone-only

### Q-003 [HIGH] How long is a bookable slot: one fixed length, or does it depend on the treatment?

- **Blocks:** FR-001 · **Category:** WORKFLOWS
- **Options:** Fixed length for all treatments / Length per treatment type
- **Suggested default:** Option: length depends on treatment type and is taken from ClinicDesk

### Q-006 [HIGH] Should patients receive appointment reminders, and if so by which channel and how far in advance?

- **Blocks:** FR-002 · **Category:** NOTIFICATIONS
- **Options:** No reminders / Email reminder / SMS reminder
- **Suggested default:** Option: no reminders in the first release; revisit after launch

### Q-007 [HIGH] Can patients cancel or reschedule online, and up to how long before the appointment?

- **Blocks:** FR-001 · **Category:** WORKFLOWS
- **Options:** No online cancellation / Cancel online up to 24 hours before
- **Suggested default:** Option: no online cancellation in the first release; patients phone the front desk

### Q-009 [HIGH] Which accessibility standard should the booking page meet?

- **Blocks:** FR-001 · **Category:** ACCESSIBILITY
- **Options:** WCAG 2.2 AA / No formal standard
- **Suggested default:** Option: WCAG 2.2 level AA

## For the team (internal) (1)

### Q-008 [HIGH] What happens when ClinicDesk is unreachable, when two people book the same slot at the same moment, or when the confirmation email cannot be sent?

- **Blocks:** IR-001, FR-002 · **Category:** ERROR_HANDLING
- **Suggested default:** Option: show the patient a "try again or phone us" message; ClinicDesk decides which booking wins
